The Name

Every wish deserves a view.

In Rajasthan, a mannat is a wish tied quietly at a shrine — made in hope, kept with patience, and returned to when it comes true. We borrowed the word on purpose. This rooftop above Chandpole Bridge has become that place for thousands who've walked in: the table where the proposal happened, the corner booked for an anniversary, the one evening someone decided was worth remembering.

Downstairs, the haveli dining room holds the same intent in dark wood, brass light and the black-and-white stone floor that runs through the whole house — carried up the stairs to the terrace above, where it meets the open sky and Lake Pichola.

— the house of Mannat
Est.Chandpole Bridge, Udaipur
Where To Sit

Two rooms, one house.

Choose the quiet warmth of the haveli, or climb to the open terrace — same kitchen, same welcome, entirely different evening.

Indoors

The Haveli Room

Jharokha arches, brass light and velvet booths on the house's signature checkerboard floor — built for long lunches, quiet dinners and families.

Open-Air

The Rooftop Terrace

Wrought-iron tables under string lights, facing Chandpole Bridge and Lake Pichola. Arrive an hour before sunset — the sky does most of the decorating.

The View

Chandpole Bridge, right outside the window.

Every table earns the lake eventually — ask for a window seat downstairs, or take the whole sky on the terrace above. Boats cross under the arches by day; the City Palace lights up across the water by night.

On The Table

A menu built for a shared table.

Tandoor smoke, wok heat, and a few things that just belong at a lake — served across both rooms, ₹1,000–1,600 for two.

Signature

Tandoori Chicken

Char-grilled over coals, plated with mint chutney and a citrus salad.

Guest favourite

Hariyali Chicken Tikka

Marinated in a herb-green masala, finished on skewers with lime and onions.

Starter

Crispy Cheese Kebabs

Golden-fried, served with a two-way dip — chilli garlic and herbed yoghurt.

For the table

Butter Chicken & Paneer

Slow-simmered gravies with jeera rice, tandoori roti and a copper-pot presentation.

Everyday

Tandoori Roti & Kadai Sabzi

Fresh off the tandoor, brushed with ghee — the way every Rajasthani thali begins.

Feast

The Full Table

Fried rice, kadai gravy, tandoori mains and roti — Mannat's version of sharing well.

Most-loved

Veg Hakka Noodles & Chilli Paneer

The dish guests mention most — wok-tossed, sesame-finished, built to share.

Sizzler

Chilli Garlic Toss

Onion, capsicum and a fried egg finish, served straight from the wok pan.

Rooftop pick

Wood-Fired Veg Pizza

Loaded crust, served with fries and a house dip — best eaten with the lake in view.

Terrace favourite

Blue Lagoon & Cold Coffee

One for the sunset photo, one for after — both served tableside on the terrace.

Morning

Paratha & Chai, Lakeside

Stuffed paratha with curd and pickle, poured tea, and Chandpole Bridge outside the window.

Full à la carte menu is at the table — this is a taste of what regulars order first.
